description: This file defines the `SugarAutoLoader` class responsible for autoloading classes, views, and widgets within the SuiteCRM system. It maps class names to file paths, manages loading logic, and includes mechanisms to handle module-specific and widget class autoloading.

classes.name: SugarAutoLoader
classes.description: A class providing static methods to automatically load class definitions and view files for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Main autoload method that loads class files based on class name, with specific handling for modules, views, and widgets.

methods.name: getFilenameForViewClass
methods.description: Determines the filename corresponding to a view class, considering module context and view type.

methods.name: getFilenameForSugarWidget
methods.description: Returns the filename for a SugarWidget class if it exists, with special handling for 'SugarWidgetField' classes.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Preloads all classes and view files mapped in the static arrays
